says: In next/, the comment says the stoppers start mergers on their own StartGrant so L3 holds apart from L1, but every stopper start is a founder letter judged by the founder's owner row, so the three stopper grant rows are never read.
proof: Removed StartChildTest.ts:152-155 and ran `vitest run --project next-integration next/packages/libfabrika/src/node/StartChild.integration.test.ts -t "Desk S1 L3"`: 1 passed. stopper_start (line 1461) calls door() whose default writer is the founder (line 717), and ChildrenLedger.ts:115-118 reads StartGrant only when no member is found.
cost: A reader trusts that L3 exercises the grant path when it does not, and the dead rows look load-bearing.
